args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), which was unhealthy with an elevated error rate (0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, and the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`rolled_out`), and the service is now healthy (error rate 0.002).

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback. The initial API call returned a 502, but I verified via `list_incidents` that the incident was created and is open.
